physics_scope.new_mathematical_object: Minimal explicit post-E19 local-in-fields quadratic wake-like tracer response; response kernel NOT supplied by existing full nonlinear Einstein-Vlasov halo/tracer dynamics.
physics_scope.fourier_convention: For real fields δ(-k)=δ(k)*, v_i(-q)=v_i(q)*. S_a(k)=integral[d3q/(2π)^3] Γ_ai(k,q) v_i(q) δ(k-q), with Γ_ai(-k,-q)=Γ_ai(k,q)*. A local real-space prototype is v·gradδ, Γ_i=i(k-q)_i. Actual E17 time-dependent kernel and LOS projection NOT measured or identified.
physics_scope.tracer_fields: δ_L=b_Lδ+λ_L S and δ_E=b_Eδ+λ_E S for one common S only as a transparent illustrative submodel; b_L,b_E,λ_L,λ_E real unknown and not fitted here.
physics_scope.cross_power_definition: P_LE(k)=<δ_L(k)δ_E(k)*>; Q(k)=P_Sδ(k)=<S(k)δ(k)*> per homogeneous volume convention.
physics_scope.first_order_formula: P_LE^(1)=b_L b_E P_δδ+λ_L b_E Q+b_L λ_E Q*+O(λ²); Im P_LE^(1)=(λ_L b_E-b_L λ_E) Im Q. If λ_L=λ_E then the contrast is proportional to b_E-b_L; orientation LE→EL complex-conjugates P. Not an actual E10 amplitude mapping.
physics_scope.mixed_bispectrum_gate: For translation-invariant means, Q(k)=∫_q Γ_i(k,q) B_{v_iδδ}(q,k-q,-k) (with momentum-conserving delta function stripped). Nonzero B and nonzero LOS-odd projection both needed for this submodel; B alone is NOT sufficient for observed ℓ=1/3.
physics_scope.gaussian_null: For jointly centered Gaussian linear v and δ, including arbitrarily nonzero two-point velocity-density correlation, all centered third moments B_vδδ=0, hence Q=0 at first order in λ for quadratic S. The no-go does NOT apply to separately allowed linear-v tracer/selection response or nonlinear response kernels without their own sign-symmetry assumptions.
physics_scope.joint_sign_inversion: If a nonlinear E10-like wind response is odd under v→−v and multiplies two linear density factors, a joint centrally symmetric distribution under (v,δ,δ)→(−v,−δ,−δ) has zero signed mean. This is conditional; not all galaxy-formation/observational terms obey this symmetry.
physics_scope.higher_order_limit: O(λ²) gives four-field moments and may be nonzero; no statement that complete eBOSS odd cross-power or all Gaussian nonlinear models vanish.
physics_scope.non_gaussian_witness: X,Y independent equiprobable ±1; V=X,D1=Y,D2=XY have zero means, vanishing all pairwise cross moments, yet <V D1 D2>=1. This is an algebraic three-variable witness only, not a physical spatial Fourier bispectrum or Vlasov simulation.
